thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: RavenPay (prod, private VPC) — NLB -> backend proxy targets flapping, elevated 5xx. Priority: P1. Runbook: /runbooks/vpc-nlb-proxy-flapping
ashley.r: Acked — I'm oncall and jumping in. Anyone have a quick impact tally from RavenPay or telemetry?
matt.l: RavenPay alerts show ~40% of egress requests getting 504 from NLB over the last 7m. Connection churn high on proxy pods in dedicated pool-A.
ops-bot: Telemetry snapshot: NLB target group tg-ravenpay-proxy at 3/6 healthy. Healthcheck failures spike: backend returned 502 / timeout on TCP handshake. Proxy pod CPU ~95%.
lee: Same here — proxy (env=prod/ravenpay, pool=dedi-A) exhibiting epoll backlog, keepalives stacking. Could be TLS renegotiation storm or upstream SYN retries from customer edge.
nashley.r: RavenPay support: customers report intermittent payment submit failures/timeouts. They routed some HV traffic to fallback but only ~20% covered.
matt.l: Quick probe — curl to a healthy pod returns 200 on /_hc but process logs show lots of "accept() EMFILE" and "write: cannot allocate memory". Suggests FD/heap pressure.
ops-bot: Note: some targets return 200 for HTTP healthcheck but fail during TLS handshake when NLB passes through — implies process saturation rather than app-level crash.
lee: Temp mitigations: 1) ask RavenPay to weight-shift traffic to pool-B; 2) flip proxy to TLS passthrough on pool-A to avoid renegotiation CPU; 3) remove clearly unhealthy targets from target group.
nashley.r: RavenPay, can you take a DNS/weight action? Their private Route53 TTL is low (30s) but controlled by customer.
ravenpay-oncall: We can bump pool-B to 60% now and open alternate SG for fallback IPs. Doing it in 60s.
matt.l: Do it. While RavenPay shifts, we’ll prepare control-plane change to enable passthrough on pool-A. That should reduce TLS CPU.
lee: Control plane change I’ll apply (non-disruptive):
```
# enable passthrough on ravenpay pool A
curl -s -X POST "https://internal.console/api/v1/customers/ravenpay/pools/dedi-A/config" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"proxy_passthrough":true, "graceful_restart":true}'
```
ops-bot: Rollback plan noted: revert passthrough and set deregistration delay to 30s if latency/regressions appear. Also queued scaling +2 pods for pool-A if CPU remains >85% after passthrough.
ravenpay-oncall: Weight shift to pool-B = 60% complete. Alternate SG opened for fallback IPs.
matt.l: Confirmed drop in aggregate 5xx after weight shift. Applying passthrough now.
lee: Passthrough applied. Logs show TLS handshake errors falling and fewer accept()/EMFILE events.
ops-bot: Target group now 5/6 healthy. NLB 5xx rate ~12% (was 40%).
nashley.r: Good containment. Keep monitoring 30m. Action items: monitor CPU and fd counts; if pool-A CPU >90% for >10m trigger auto-scale and paging to infra. Request RavenPay tune TCP keepalive (increase idle) to reduce connection churn.
nora: I'll take the 03:00Z -> 11:00Z on-call handoff and own postmortem. ashley.r handing off now. Saving notes to incident doc: /incidents/1762309999/ravenpay-privnet-proxy-tailspin
ashley.r: Handoff done. Follow-ups: schedule a joint load test and verify kernel fd limits on proxy image; consider conntrack/epoll tuning on host. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident update — severity downgraded to P2. Last update at 1762313600. If behaviour reappears, re-open P1.
